annotations.title: Check a text for AI-sounding phrases

description: Run the writer linter behind mikefluff.com/ai-text-checker on a text: it flags the stock phrases and rhythms readers recognise as machine-written ("in today's fast-paced world", "it's important to note", em-dash habits in Russian) and returns a density verdict (clean / borderline / neuroslop suspected), a pass/fail gate for hard bans, and each hit with line, column, category and the matched words. English and Russian only. Up to 20000 characters. It judges the text, not who wrote it. Read-only: the text is not stored.
